secret: Remove the secret from the file. If it was ever real, replace it with a new one at the service that issued it.
no-unused-vars: Delete the unused name. If it must stay for a signature, start it with an underscore (_name).
prefer-const: Change let to const: the value is never reassigned.
no-var: Use const, or let if the value changes later. Never var.
eqeqeq: Use === and !== so values are not converted before comparing.
no-new: Assign the new object to a name and use it, or call a function instead of new.
no-throw-literal: Throw an Error object: throw new Error("what went wrong").
no-useless-catch: Delete the try/catch: a catch that only rethrows does nothing.
no-shadow: Rename the inner name: it hides an outer name with the same spelling.
preserve-caught-error: Pass the caught error on: throw new Error("what failed", { cause: error }).
unicorn/consistent-function-scoping: Move the inner function to the top level of the file: it uses nothing from the function around it.
unicorn/no-array-sort: Use toSorted(), which returns a sorted copy, instead of sort(), which changes the array in place.
no-unsafe-optional-chaining: Add a fallback after ?. (for example: (a?.b ?? []).map) so the code cannot run on undefined.
typescript/no-explicit-any: Write the real type. If it is truly unknown, use unknown and narrow it with a check.
typescript/no-non-null-assertion: Remove the ! and handle the missing case: an if check, ?? with a fallback, or an early return.
typescript/consistent-type-imports: Import types with "import type { X }" so they disappear from the built code.
typescript/prefer-ts-expect-error: Remove @ts-ignore and fix the type. In a test file, write @ts-expect-error: <reason> instead, so it fails once the error is gone.
react/exhaustive-deps: Add every value the hook reads to its dependency list, or move the value inside the hook.
react/hooks: Call hooks only at the top level of a component or custom hook: never inside if, loops, or callbacks.
react/set-state-in-effect: Compute the value during render instead of copying it into state from an effect.
react/jsx-key: Give each item in a list a key prop with a stable id from the data.
react/no-array-index-key: Use a stable id from the item as the key, not its position in the list.
unicorn/prefer-node-protocol: Write the Node built-in with its prefix: "node:fs", not "fs".
import/no-cycle: Two files import each other. Move the shared code into a third file both can import.
import/no-duplicates: Merge the two imports from the same module into one import line.
jest/expect-expect: The test checks nothing. Add an expect(...) that fails if the behavior breaks.
jest/valid-expect: Finish the expect: call a matcher such as expect(x).toBe(y), and await it if it returns a promise.
